# Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(lmerTest)
library(kableExtra)
library(patchwork)
theme_set(theme_minimal())

PAL_TYPE  <- c("LLM" = "#4477AA", "Human" = "#AA3377")          # persuader type
PAL_TRUTH <- c("Truth" = "#009988", "Falsehood" = "#CC3311")    # assigned position
PAL_HELP  <- c("Helpful" = "#4DAF4A", "Mixed" = "#999999", "Unhelpful" = "#E41A1C")

data_dir <- "../data"
stats_dir <- "stats"
tags_dir <- "../data/tags"
```

```{r load-data}
tags <- read.csv(file.path(tags_dir, "final_ratings.csv"))
tags_raw <- read.csv(file.path(tags_dir, "final_ratings_raw.csv"))

if (file.exists("../data/tags/final_ratings_addendum.csv")) {
  tags <- bind_rows(tags, read.csv("../data/tags/final_ratings_addendum.csv"))
  tags_raw <- bind_rows(tags_raw, read.csv("../data/tags/final_ratings_raw_addendum.csv"))
}
corr_old <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "corrigibility_tags.csv"))

conv <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "conversation_Conversation.csv"))
questions <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "conversation_Question.csv"))

trials <- bind_rows(lapply(c("e1", "e2", "e3", "e4"), function(e)
  read.csv(sprintf("%s/%s_trials.csv", stats_dir, e))))

# Tag metadata: display labels, role/type, and IRR from the original write-up
# (Cohen's kappa between the two human raters; Krippendorff's alpha across
# humans + the FINAL tagger, not the GPT-majority; tagging/irr_report.pdf Table 1).
tag_info <- tribble(
  ~tag,                       ~label,                  ~role,       ~type,        ~kappa, ~alpha,
  "deception_false",          "False statements",      "Persuader", "Deception",  0.76,   0.76,
  "deception_misleading",     "Misleading statements", "Persuader", "Deception",  0.36,   0.44,
  "deception_provably_false", "Provably false",        "Persuader", "Deception",  0.60,   0.69,
  "persuader_math",           "Math",                  "Persuader", "Content",    0.68,   0.63,
  "persuader_principle",      "Principle",             "Persuader", "Content",    0.59,   0.62,
  "persuader_analogy",        "Analogy",               "Persuader", "Content",    0.61,   0.59,
  "persuader_authority",      "Authority",             "Persuader", "Content",    0.56,   0.70,
  "persuader_acknowledge",    "Acknowledge",           "Persuader", "Social",     0.63,   0.51,
  "persuader_flattery",       "Flattery",              "Persuader", "Social",     0.53,   0.59,
  "persuader_personal",       "Personal",              "Persuader", "Social",     0.63,   0.69,
  "persuader_gave_up",        "Concession",            "Persuader", "Concession", 0.48,   0.51,
  "target_probe",             "Probing statements",    "Target",    "Response",   0.62,   0.67,
  "target_disagreement",      "Disagreement",          "Target",    "Response",   0.60,   0.46,
  "target_question",          "Question (opener)",     "Target",    "Opener",     0.86,   0.86,
  "target_statement",         "Statement (opener)",    "Target",    "Opener",     0.84,   0.85
)
# kable escapes the "|" in "Pr(>|z|)" as &#124; in HTML output, which renders badly.
# coef_tab() pulls a coefficient matrix, rounds it, and gives the columns clean names.
coef_tab <- function(x, digits = 3) {
  co <- if (is.matrix(x)) x else summary(x)$coefficients
  co <- round(co, digits)
  colnames(co) <- colnames(co) %>%
    sub("Pr\\(>\\|[tz]\\|\\)", "p", .) %>%
    sub("^Std. Error$", "SE", .) %>%
    sub("^t value$", "t", .) %>%
    sub("^z value$", "z", .) %>%
    sub("^Estimate$", "b", .)
  co
}

paper_tags <- setdiff(tag_info$tag, "deception_provably_false")
persuader_tags <- setdiff(tag_info$tag[tag_info$role == "Persuader"], "deception_provably_false")
target_tags <- tag_info$tag[tag_info$role == "Target"]
```

```{r assemble}
conv_map <- conv %>%
  select(conversation_id = id, participant_id, question_id, trial_index, human_persuader_id)

d <- trials %>%
  left_join(conv_map, by = c("participant_id", "question_id", "trial_index")) %>%
  left_join(tags, by = "conversation_id") %>%
  left_join(questions %>% select(question_id = id, q_name = name, q_subcategory = subcategory),
            by = "question_id") %>%
  mutate(
    experiment = factor(experiment),
    tagged = !is.na(persuader_gave_up),
    persuader_type = factor(ifelse(interaction_type == "human_human", "Human", "LLM"),
                            levels = c("LLM", "Human")),
    truth = factor(ifelse(persuader_correct, "Truth", "Falsehood"),
                   levels = c("Truth", "Falsehood")),
    disagree = participant_persuader_disagree,
    intro_condition = factor(intro_condition, levels = c("Helpful", "Mixed", "Unhelpful")),
    mind_changed = (disagree & persuader_success) | (!disagree & !persuader_success),
    conf_pre_z = as.numeric(scale(confidence_pre))
  )

# Persuader honesty (E4 human persuaders only): did the persuader's OWN
# pre-conversation answer match the side they were assigned to argue?
# Derivation follows e4.Rmd L1040-1054. Derived, not manipulated: random
# assignment crossed with the persuader's private belief. Available for all 614.
qr_pre <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "conversation_QuestionResponse.csv")) %>%
  filter(response_type == "pre") %>%
  select(question_id, human_persuader_id = participant_id,
         persuader_response_pre = response, persuader_confidence_pre = confidence)

honesty <- d %>%
  filter(interaction_type == "human_human") %>%
  select(conversation_id, question_id, human_persuader_id) %>%
  left_join(conv %>% select(conversation_id = id, persuader_answer), by = "conversation_id") %>%
  left_join(questions %>% select(question_id = id, answer1, answer2), by = "question_id") %>%
  left_join(qr_pre, by = c("question_id", "human_persuader_id")) %>%
  mutate(persuader_honest = ifelse(persuader_response_pre == answer1, "answer1", "answer2")
           == persuader_answer) %>%
  select(conversation_id, persuader_response_pre, persuader_confidence_pre, persuader_honest)

stopifnot(!any(duplicated(honesty$conversation_id)))
d <- d %>% left_join(honesty, by = "conversation_id")

# Analysis samples
dc <- d %>% filter(hint_condition == "Conversation", tagged)   # tagged conversation trials
dd <- dc %>% filter(disagree)                                  # persuasion-at-stake trials

cat(sprintf("honesty available for %d/%d tagged human-persuader conversations\n",
            sum(dc$persuader_type == "Human" & !is.na(dc$persuader_honest)),
            sum(dc$persuader_type == "Human")))
```

# Reliability & coverage

## Coverage of the samples

```{r coverage}
d %>%
  filter(hint_condition == "Conversation") %>%
  group_by(experiment, persuader_type) %>%
  summarize(
    conversation_trials = n(),
    pct_tagged = round(100 * mean(tagged), 1),
    tagged = sum(tagged),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  relocate(pct_tagged, .after = tagged) %>%
  kable(caption = "Tag coverage of conversation trials") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r export-untagged}
untagged_ids <- d %>%
  filter(hint_condition == "Conversation", !tagged) %>%
  pull(conversation_id)

messages <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "conversation_Message.csv"))
untagged_export <- messages %>%
  filter(conversation_id %in% untagged_ids) %>%
  left_join(
    d %>% select(conversation_id, question_id) %>%
      left_join(questions %>%
                  select(question_id = id, question, answer1, answer2), by = "question_id") %>%
      left_join(conv %>% select(conversation_id = id, persuader_answer), by = "conversation_id") %>%
      mutate(persuader_answer = ifelse(persuader_answer == "answer1", answer1, answer2)) %>%
      select(-question_id),
    by = "conversation_id"
  ) %>%
  select(conversation_id, id, sender_role, content, timestamp, cost,
         question, answer1, answer2, persuader_answer)

if (nrow(untagged_export) > 0) {
  write.csv(untagged_export, "untagged_conversations.csv", row.names = FALSE, na = "")
  cat(n_distinct(untagged_export$conversation_id),
      "untagged conversations exported to untagged_conversations.csv\n")
} else {
  cat(length(untagged_ids), "conversation trials remain untagged,",
      "all with empty transcripts (nothing to tag)\n")
}
```

## Reliability and prevalence

```{r prevalence-table}
prev <- dc %>%
  summarize(across(all_of(tag_info$tag), mean)) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "tag", values_to = "prevalence")

tag_info %>%
  left_join(prev, by = "tag") %>%
  arrange(role, type, -prevalence) %>%
  mutate(prevalence = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * prevalence)) %>%
  select(Role = role, Type = type, Category = label, `Prevalence` = prevalence,
         `Human kappa` = kappa, `K. alpha (H+LLM)` = alpha) %>%
  kable(caption = "Final categories: prevalence in tagged sample + IRR from validation set") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

## Old vs new "giving up" tags

```{r old-vs-new-gaveup}
overlap <- corr_old %>%
  inner_join(tags %>% select(conversation_id, persuader_gave_up), by = "conversation_id") %>%
  mutate(old = ifelse(corrigibility_tag %in% c("Yes", "Unclear"), 1, 0),
         new = persuader_gave_up)

tab <- table(Old = overlap$old, New = overlap$new)
po <- sum(diag(tab)) / sum(tab)
pe <- sum(rowSums(tab) * colSums(tab)) / sum(tab)^2
kappa_oldnew <- (po - pe) / (1 - pe)

kable(tab, caption = sprintf(
  "Old (gpt-4.1-mini, Unclear=Yes) vs new gave-up tags; n = %d, agreement = %.1f%%, kappa = %.2f",
  sum(tab), 100 * po, kappa_oldnew)) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

overlap %>%
  summarize(`Old prevalence` = mean(old), `New prevalence` = mean(new)) %>%
  kable(digits = 3) %>% kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

## Humans vs LLMs (E4)

```{r fit-helpers}
# Fit one glmer per tag; extract the coefficient for `term`; BH-correct.
fit_per_tag <- function(data, tag_cols, rhs, term, outcome = NULL, family = "binomial") {
  map_dfr(tag_cols, function(tg) {
    lhs <- if (is.null(outcome)) tg else outcome
    rhs_full <- if (is.null(outcome)) rhs else paste(tg, "+", rhs)
    f <- as.formula(paste(lhs, "~", rhs_full))
    fit <- tryCatch({
      if (family == "binomial") {
        glmer(f, data = data, family = binomial,
              control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", calc.derivs = FALSE))
      } else {
        lmer(f, data = data)
      }
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(fit)) return(tibble(tag = tg, term = term, b = NA))
    co <- summary(fit)$coefficients
    row <- grep(paste0("^", term), rownames(co), value = TRUE)[1]
    if (is.na(row)) return(tibble(tag = tg, term = term, b = NA))
    tibble(
      tag = tg, term = term,
      b = co[row, "Estimate"], se = co[row, "Std. Error"],
      stat = co[row, ncol(co) - 1], p = co[row, ncol(co)],
      singular = isSingular(fit)
    )
  }) %>%
    mutate(p_bh = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>%
    left_join(tag_info %>% select(tag, label, role, type, kappa), by = "tag")
}

TYPE_LV <- c("Deception", "Content", "Social", "Concession", "Response", "Opener")
PAL_CAT <- c(Deception = "#CC3311", Content = "#0077BB", Social = "#EE7733",
             Concession = "#AA3377", Response = "#009988", Opener = "#777777")
SIGCOL <- c("BH p < .05" = "#CC3311", "n.s." = "grey45")

# Forest plot of per-tag odds ratios.
#   layout = "effect"   -> facet by role (Persuader / Target), rows sorted by effect
#                          size, tag category shown as a coloured swatch in the margin.
#   layout = "category" -> nested strips (role then category); rows grouped by category
#                          and sorted by effect within group.
# A background-band version was tried and dropped: sorting by effect size interleaves
# categories, so the bands are not contiguous unless you group by category (= "category").
or_forest <- function(res, title, xlab = "Odds ratio", layout = c("effect", "category"),
                      max_se = 5) {
  layout <- match.arg(layout)
  d <- res %>%
    filter(!is.na(b), se < max_se) %>%
    mutate(sig = ifelse(p_bh < .05, "BH p < .05", "n.s."),
           type = factor(type, levels = TYPE_LV),
           role = factor(role, levels = c("Persuader", "Target")),
           label = fct_reorder(label, b))
  lim <- range(c(exp(d$b - 1.96 * d$se), exp(d$b + 1.96 * d$se)), na.rm = TRUE) * c(0.75, 1.3)

  p <- ggplot(d, aes(exp(b), label)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey65") +
    geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = exp(b - 1.96 * se), xmax = exp(b + 1.96 * se), colour = sig),
                    size = .4) +
    scale_x_log10(limits = lim) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = SIGCOL, name = NULL) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = NULL, title = title) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

  if (layout == "effect") {
    p + geom_point(aes(x = lim[1] * 1.15, fill = type), shape = 22, size = 2.8, stroke = 0) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = PAL_CAT, name = "Category") +
      facet_grid(role ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y")
  } else {
    p + facet_grid(role + type ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
      theme(strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1, size = 7.5),
            strip.placement = "outside")
  }
}


fmt_res <- function(res) {
  res %>%
    arrange(p) %>%
    transmute(Category = label, Role = role, OR = round(exp(b), 2),
              b = round(b, 2), SE = round(se, 2), z = round(stat, 2),
              p = signif(p, 2), `p (BH)` = signif(p_bh, 2),
              kappa = kappa, singular = singular)
}
```

# When are strategies used?

## Arguing truth vs falsehood

```{r truth-tags, fig.height=5}
llm <- dc %>% filter(persuader_type == "LLM")

res_truth <- fit_per_tag(
  llm, paper_tags,
  rhs = "truth + experiment + disagree + (1 | question_id) + (1 | participant_id)",
  term = "truthFalsehood"
)

or_forest(res_truth, "Assigned falsehood vs truth (LLM persuaders): OR > 1 = more common when arguing falsehood")
fmt_res(res_truth) %>% kable(caption = "Tag ~ assigned position (LLM, E1-E4)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r truth-tags-human, fig.height=5}
hum <- dc %>% filter(persuader_type == "Human")

res_truth_h <- fit_per_tag(
  hum, paper_tags,
  rhs = "truth + disagree + (1 | question_id) + (1 | participant_id)",
  term = "truthFalsehood"
)

or_forest(res_truth_h, "Assigned falsehood vs truth (human persuaders, E4)")
fmt_res(res_truth_h) %>% kable() %>% kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

# Which strategies predict success?

```{r success-per-tag, fig.height=9}
ddl <- dd %>% filter(persuader_type == "LLM")

res_succ <- map_dfr(paper_tags, function(tg) {
  f <- as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~", tg,
    "+ truth + conf_pre_z + experiment + (1 | question_id) + (1 | participant_id)"))
  fit <- tryCatch(
    glmer(f, data = ddl, family = binomial,
          control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", calc.derivs = FALSE)),
    error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) return(tibble(tag = tg, b = NA))
  co <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  tibble(tag = tg, b = co[tg, "Estimate"], se = co[tg, "Std. Error"],
         stat = co[tg, "z value"], p = co[tg, "Pr(>|z|)"], singular = isSingular(fit))
}) %>%
  mutate(p_bh = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>%
  left_join(tag_info %>% select(tag, label, role, type, kappa), by = "tag")

or_forest(res_succ, "Persuasion success ~ tag (disagreement trials, LLM persuaders)")

or_forest(res_succ, "Same models, grouped by category", layout = "category")
fmt_res(res_succ %>% mutate(term = tag)) %>%
  kable(caption = "Per-tag mixed logistic models: persuader_success ~ tag + truth + confidence + experiment + (1|q) + (1|ppt)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

## Joint model (persuader tags entered together)

```{r success-joint}
f_joint <- as.formula(paste(
  "persuader_success ~", paste(persuader_tags, collapse = " + "),
  "+ truth + conf_pre_z + experiment + (1 | question_id) + (1 | participant_id)"))
m_joint <- glmer(f_joint, data = ddl, family = binomial,
                 control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", calc.derivs = FALSE))
co <- summary(m_joint)$coefficients
as.data.frame(co) %>%
  rownames_to_column("term") %>%
  filter(term %in% persuader_tags) %>%
  left_join(tag_info %>% select(term = tag, label), by = "term") %>%
  arrange(`Pr(>|z|)`) %>%
  transmute(Category = label, OR = round(exp(Estimate), 2), b = round(Estimate, 2),
            SE = round(`Std. Error`, 2), z = round(`z value`, 2), p = signif(`Pr(>|z|)`, 2)) %>%
  kable(caption = "Joint model: all persuader tags simultaneously") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

## Adjusted model

```{r success-adjusted}
adj_tags <- setdiff(persuader_tags, "deception_provably_false")
f_adj <- as.formula(paste(
  "persuader_success ~", paste(adj_tags, collapse = " + "),
  "+ target_disagreement + target_probe + truth + conf_pre_z + experiment",
  "+ (1 | question_id) + (1 | participant_id)"))
m_adj <- glmer(f_adj, data = ddl, family = binomial,
               control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)))
co <- summary(m_adj)$coefficients
res_adj <- as.data.frame(co) %>%
  rownames_to_column("tag") %>%
  filter(tag %in% c(persuader_tags, "target_disagreement", "target_probe")) %>%
  transmute(tag, b = Estimate, se = `Std. Error`, stat = `z value`, p = `Pr(>|z|)`,
            singular = isSingular(m_adj)) %>%
  mutate(p_bh = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>%
  left_join(tag_info %>% select(tag, label, role, type, kappa), by = "tag")

or_forest(res_adj, "Adjusted: all persuader tags jointly + target behaviour (LLM disagreement trials)")
fmt_res(res_adj %>% mutate(term = tag)) %>%
  kable(caption = "Adjusted success model: all persuader tags + target disagreement/probing + truth + confidence + experiment + (1|q) + (1|ppt)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

## Confidence change as outcome

```{r cc-per-tag, fig.height=5}
dcl <- dc %>% filter(persuader_type == "LLM")

res_cc <- map_dfr(paper_tags, function(tg) {
  f <- as.formula(paste("confidence_change ~", tg,
    "+ truth + disagree + conf_pre_z + experiment + (1 | question_id) + (1 | participant_id)"))
  fit <- tryCatch(lmer(f, data = dcl), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) return(tibble(tag = tg, b = NA))
  co <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  tibble(tag = tg, b = co[tg, "Estimate"], se = co[tg, "Std. Error"],
         stat = co[tg, "t value"], p = co[tg, "Pr(>|t|)"], singular = isSingular(fit))
}) %>%
  mutate(p_bh = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>%
  left_join(tag_info %>% select(tag, label, role, type, kappa), by = "tag")

res_cc %>%
  filter(!is.na(b)) %>%
  mutate(sig = ifelse(p_bh < .05, "BH p < .05", "n.s.")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = b, y = reorder(label, b), color = sig)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = b - 1.96 * se, xmax = b + 1.96 * se)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("BH p < .05" = "#CC3311", "n.s." = "grey40")) +
  labs(x = "b (percentage points of confidence toward persuader)", y = NULL, color = NULL,
       title = "Confidence change ~ tag (all conversation trials, LLM)")

fmt_res(res_cc %>% mutate(term = tag)) %>% select(-OR) %>%
  kable(caption = "b = percentage points of confidence change toward the persuader") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

## Do the same strategies work for humans? (E4)

```{r success-by-type-side-by-side, fig.height=5}
dd4 <- dd %>% filter(experiment == "E4")

res_within <- map_dfr(c("LLM", "Human"), function(pt) {
  map_dfr(persuader_tags, function(tg) {
    dsub <- dd4 %>% filter(persuader_type == pt)
    if (mean(dsub[[tg]]) < 0.03 || mean(dsub[[tg]]) > 0.97) return(tibble(tag = tg, b = NA))
    f <- as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~", tg, "+ truth + conf_pre_z + (1 | question_id)"))
    fit <- tryCatch(glmer(f, data = dsub, family = binomial,
                          control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", calc.derivs = FALSE)),
                    error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(fit)) return(tibble(tag = tg, b = NA))
    co <- summary(fit)$coefficients
    tibble(tag = tg, b = co[tg, "Estimate"], se = co[tg, "Std. Error"], p = co[tg, "Pr(>|z|)"])
  }) %>% mutate(persuader = pt)
}) %>%
  filter(!is.na(b), se < 5) %>%
  left_join(tag_info %>% select(tag, label, type), by = "tag") %>%
  mutate(type = factor(type, levels = TYPE_LV))

ggplot(res_within, aes(exp(b), fct_reorder(label, b), colour = persuader)) +

                  position = position_dodge(width = .55), size = .4) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = PAL_TYPE, name = "Persuader") +
  facet_grid(type ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  labs(x = "Odds ratio for persuader success", y = NULL,
       title = "Within-type strategy payoffs (E4 disagreement trials)") +
```

```{r success-type-ixn, fig.height=4}
res_ixn <- map_dfr(persuader_tags, function(tg) {
  f <- as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~", tg, "* persuader_type",
    "+ truth + conf_pre_z + (1 | question_id) + (1 | participant_id)"))
  fit <- tryCatch(glmer(f, data = dd4, family = binomial,

or_forest(res_ixn %>% filter(!is.na(b), se < 5),
```

### Can the human/LLM success gap be decomposed into strategy? Mostly no.

```{r human-llm-gap-decomposition}
gap <- function(extra, lab) {
  f <- as.formula(paste0("persuader_success ~ persuader_type", extra,
                         " + truth + conf_pre_z + (1 | question_id)"))
  m <- glmer(f, data = dd4, family = binomial,
             control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", calc.derivs = FALSE))
  co <- summary(m)$coefficients
  r <- grep("persuader_typeHuman$", rownames(co), value = TRUE)[1]
  tibble(model = lab, b_human = co[r, 1], OR_human = exp(co[r, 1]), p = co[r, 4])
}
bind_rows(
  gap("", "raw human-vs-LLM gap"),
  gap(" + persuader_gave_up", "+ giving up"),
  gap(paste0(" + ", paste(setdiff(persuader_tags, "persuader_gave_up"), collapse = " + ")),
      "+ all other persuader tags"),
  gap(paste0(" + ", paste(persuader_tags, collapse = " + ")), "+ all persuader tags")
) %>%
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "Human-vs-LLM success gap, before and after holding strategy constant (OR < 1 = humans worse)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

# Causal probes for the strategy-success findings

```{r focal-tags}
focal_tags <- c("persuader_flattery", "persuader_personal", "deception_misleading",
                "persuader_authority", "persuader_acknowledge")
```

## Probe A: opening-move strategies (temporal precedence)

```{r probe-a-init}
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

### Is opening-move flattery just elicited by the opener?

```{r probe-a-opener-controls}
messages_all <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "conversation_Message.csv"))
opener <- messages_all %>%
  arrange(conversation_id, id) %>%
  group_by(conversation_id) %>% slice_head(n = 1) %>% ungroup() %>%
  transmute(conversation_id, opener_len = nchar(content))
ddfl <- ddf %>% filter(persuader_type == "LLM") %>%
  left_join(opener, by = "conversation_id") %>%
  mutate(opener_len_z = as.numeric(scale(log1p(opener_len))))

m_fm_elicit <- glmer(fm_persuader_flattery ~ fm_target_question + fm_target_statement +
                       fm_target_disagreement + fm_target_probe + opener_len_z + conf_pre_z +
                       truth + experiment + (1 | question_id) + (1 | participant_id),
                     data = ddfl, family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
coef_tab(m_fm_elicit) %>% kable(caption = "What predicts opening-move flattery (LLM)?") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

fm_other <- paste0("fm_", setdiff(persuader_tags, c("persuader_flattery", "persuader_gave_up", "deception_provably_false")))
m_fm_ctrl <- glmer(as.formula(paste(
  "persuader_success ~ fm_persuader_flattery +", paste(fm_other, collapse = " + "),
  "+ fm_target_question + fm_target_statement + fm_target_disagreement + fm_target_probe + opener_len_z",
  "+ truth + conf_pre_z + experiment + (1 | question_id) + (1 | participant_id)")),
  data = ddfl, family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)))
coef_tab(m_fm_ctrl) %>% kable(caption = "Opening-move flattery -> success, controlling opener features + all other opening-move tags") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

# Per-tag opening-move models with the opener controls (this is what Fig 6c shows):
# same covariates as the per-tag success models, plus the target's opening
# message (type, disagreement, probing, log length).
res_fm_ctrl <- map_dfr(focal_tags, function(tg) {
  v <- paste0("fm_", tg)
  f <- as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~", v,
    "+ fm_target_question + fm_target_statement + fm_target_disagreement + fm_target_probe + opener_len_z",
    "+ truth + conf_pre_z + experiment + (1 | question_id) + (1 | participant_id)"))
  fit <- tryCatch(glmer(f, data = ddfl, family = binomial,
                        control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) return(tibble(tag = tg, b = NA))
  co <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  tibble(tag = tg, version = "opening_ctrl", b = co[v, "Estimate"], se = co[v, "Std. Error"],
         z = co[v, "z value"], p = co[v, "Pr(>|z|)"])
}) %>% left_join(tag_info %>% select(tag, label), by = "tag")
res_fm_ctrl %>% transmute(Category = label, OR = round(exp(b), 2), SE = round(se, 2), p = signif(p, 2)) %>%
  kable(caption = "Opening-move tags -> success, per tag, controlling for the target's opening message (Fig 6c)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

## Flattery audit: what is actually inside the tag?

```{r flattery-decomposition}
first_p <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "conversation_Message.csv")) %>%
  filter(sender_role == "P") %>%
  group_by(conversation_id) %>% arrange(id) %>% slice(1) %>% ungroup() %>%
  select(conversation_id, first_msg = content)

# Compliments the TARGET (their reasoning / intelligence / answer)
COMPL <- paste0(
  "(?i)you'?re (absolutely |totally |exactly |so |really )?(right|correct|sharp|spot[- ]on|onto|close)|",
  "spot[- ]on|you'?ve got (it|great)|you'?re doing great|you nailed|well reasoned|impressive|",
  "(good|great|nice|smart|sharp|excellent) (intuition|instinct|instincts|thinking|logic|reasoning|",
  "catch|call|guess|eye|job|work|point|observation)|(smart|clever) (way|approach)|",
  "good (thought|thinking)|nice (one|catch)")
# Praises the QUESTION -- a discourse formula, not target-directed
QPRAISE <- "(?i)(great|good|excellent|interesting|fair) question"

flat <- ddf %>%                      # ddf = dd joined to the first-message tags
  filter(persuader_type == "LLM") %>%
  left_join(first_p, by = "conversation_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(fm_persuader_flattery), !is.na(first_msg)) %>%
  mutate(compl_target = as.integer(grepl(COMPL, first_msg, perl = TRUE)),
         praise_q = as.integer(grepl(QPRAISE, first_msg, perl = TRUE)))

flat %>%
  group_by(`opening flattery tag` = fm_persuader_flattery) %>%
  summarize(n = n(),
            `target compliment` = sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * mean(compl_target)),
            `"Great question!"` = sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * mean(praise_q)),
            neither = sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * mean(!compl_target & !praise_q)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  kable(caption = "Composition of the opening-move flattery tag") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r flattery-decomposition-models}
fit_probeA <- function(term, lab) {
  f <- as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~", term,
    "+ truth + conf_pre_z + experiment + (1 | question_id) + (1 | participant_id)"))
  m <- glmer(f, data = flat, family = binomial,
             control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", calc.derivs = FALSE))
  co <- summary(m)$coefficients
  tibble(predictor = lab, n_positive = sum(flat[[term]]), OR = exp(co[term, 1]),
         CI = sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", exp(co[term, 1] - 1.96 * co[term, 2]),
                      exp(co[term, 1] + 1.96 * co[term, 2])),
         p = co[term, 4])
}
bind_rows(
  fit_probeA("fm_persuader_flattery", "tagger: opening flattery"),
  fit_probeA("compl_target", "target-directed compliment"),
  fit_probeA("praise_q", "\"Great question!\" formula")
) %>%
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "Probe-A spec applied to each component of the flattery tag") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

m_race <- glmer(persuader_success ~ compl_target + praise_q + truth + conf_pre_z +
                  experiment + (1 | question_id) + (1 | participant_id),
                data = flat, family = binomial,
                control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", calc.derivs = FALSE))
coef_tab(summary(m_race)$coefficients[2:3, ], 4) %>%
  kable(caption = "Both components entered together") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

## Probe B: within-persuader style (E4 human persuaders)

```{r probe-b}
hp <- dc %>%
  filter(persuader_type == "Human", !is.na(human_persuader_id), human_persuader_id != "") %>%
  group_by(human_persuader_id) %>%
  mutate(n_games = n()) %>%
  filter(n_games >= 3) %>%
  ungroup()

loo <- hp %>%
  group_by(human_persuader_id) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(focal_tags),
                ~ (sum(.x) - .x) / (n() - 1), .names = "loo_{.col}")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(disagree)
cat(nrow(loo), "disagreement trials;", n_distinct(loo$human_persuader_id), "persuaders\n")

res_loo <- map_dfr(focal_tags, function(tg) {
  v <- paste0("loo_", tg)
  f <- as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~", v,
    "+ truth + conf_pre_z + (1 | question_id)"))
  fit <- tryCatch(glmer(f, data = loo, family = binomial,
                        control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")),
                  error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) return(tibble(tag = tg, b = NA))
  co <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  tibble(tag = tg, b = co[v, "Estimate"], se = co[v, "Std. Error"],
         z = co[v, "z value"], p = co[v, "Pr(>|z|)"])
}) %>% left_join(tag_info %>% select(tag, label), by = "tag")

# Binary version (Fig 6d): did the persuader use the tag in ANY of their other
# games? Puts the estimate on the same odds-ratio-for-success scale as 6b/6c.
loo <- loo %>% mutate(across(all_of(paste0("loo_", focal_tags)), ~ as.numeric(.x > 0), .names = "any_{.col}"))
res_loo_any <- map_dfr(focal_tags, function(tg) {
  v <- paste0("any_loo_", tg)
  f <- as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~", v, "+ truth + conf_pre_z + (1 | question_id)"))
  fit <- tryCatch(glmer(f, data = loo, family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")),
                  error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) return(tibble(tag = tg, b = NA))
  co <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  tibble(tag = tg, n_users = sum(loo[[v]]), b = co[v, "Estimate"], se = co[v, "Std. Error"],
         z = co[v, "z value"], p = co[v, "Pr(>|z|)"])
}) %>% left_join(tag_info %>% select(tag, label), by = "tag")
res_loo_any %>% transmute(Category = label, `trials with habitual user` = n_users, OR = round(exp(b), 2),
                          SE = round(se, 2), p = signif(p, 2)) %>%
  kable(caption = "Focal-game success ~ persuader used the tag in at least one OTHER game (E4 humans, disagreement trials)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

res_loo %>%
  transmute(Category = label, `b (0-1 habitual rate)` = round(b, 2), SE = round(se, 2),
            OR = round(exp(b), 2), z = round(z, 2), p = signif(p, 2)) %>%
  kable(caption = "Focal-game success ~ persuader's leave-one-out habitual strategy rate (E4 humans, disagreement trials). Low power - directional evidence only.") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

## Probe C: robustness ladder (added controls + within centering)

```{r probe-c, fig.height=4.5}
ladder_specs <- list(
  M1_baseline = "%s + truth + conf_pre_z + experiment",
  M2_target_behavior = "%s + target_disagreement + target_probe + truth + conf_pre_z + experiment",
  M3_trial_position = "%s + trial_index + trial_type + truth + conf_pre_z + experiment",
  M4_mundlak = "%s + ppt_mean + q_mean + truth + conf_pre_z + experiment"
)

res_ladder <- map_dfr(focal_tags, function(tg) {
  dat <- ddl %>%
    group_by(participant_id) %>% mutate(ppt_mean = mean(.data[[tg]])) %>%
    group_by(question_id) %>% mutate(q_mean = mean(.data[[tg]])) %>%
    ungroup()
  map_dfr(names(ladder_specs), function(sp) {
    f <- as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~", sprintf(ladder_specs[[sp]], tg),
                          "+ (1 | question_id) + (1 | participant_id)"))
    fit <- tryCatch(glmer(f, data = dat, family = binomial,
                          control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", calc.derivs = FALSE)),
                    error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(fit)) return(tibble(spec = sp, b = NA))
    co <- summary(fit)$coefficients
    tibble(spec = sp, b = co[tg, "Estimate"], se = co[tg, "Std. Error"],
           z = co[tg, "z value"], p = co[tg, "Pr(>|z|)"])
  }) %>% mutate(tag = tg)
}) %>% left_join(tag_info %>% select(tag, label), by = "tag")

res_ladder %>%
  filter(!is.na(b)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = exp(b), y = label, color = spec)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = exp(b - 1.96 * se), xmax = exp(b + 1.96 * se)),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(x = "OR for persuasion success", y = NULL, color = "Specification",
       title = "Robustness ladder (LLM disagreement trials)")

res_ladder %>%
  transmute(Category = label, Spec = spec, OR = round(exp(b), 2), b = round(b, 2),
            SE = round(se, 2), p = signif(p, 2)) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = Category, names_from = Spec, values_from = c(OR, p)) %>%
  kable(caption = "OR and p by specification") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

## Probe D: E-values (sensitivity to unmeasured confounding)

```{r probe-d}
evalue <- function(or) {
  rr <- sqrt(or); rr <- ifelse(rr < 1, 1 / rr, rr)
  rr + sqrt(rr * (rr - 1))
}
res_succ %>%
  filter(tag %in% focal_tags) %>%
  mutate(
    ci_lo = exp(b - 1.96 * se), ci_hi = exp(b + 1.96 * se),
    ci_near = ifelse(exp(b) > 1, ci_lo, ci_hi),
    `E-value (point)` = round(evalue(exp(b)), 2),
    `E-value (CI)` = ifelse((ci_lo - 1) * (ci_hi - 1) < 0, 1, round(evalue(ci_near), 2))
  ) %>%
  transmute(Category = label, OR = round(exp(b), 2),
            CI = sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", ci_lo, ci_hi),
            `E-value (point)`, `E-value (CI)`) %>%
  kable(caption = "E-values for focal strategy-success associations (M1 baseline)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r gaveup-models}
m_gu_truth <- glmer(
  persuader_gave_up ~ truth + disagree + experiment + (1 | question_id) + (1 | participant_id),
  data = dc %>% filter(persuader_type == "LLM"), family = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
coef_tab(m_gu_truth, 3) %>%
  kable(caption = "LLM giving up ~ assigned position + disagreement + experiment") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

m_gu_type <- glmer(
  persuader_gave_up ~ persuader_type + truth + (1 | question_id) + (1 | participant_id),
  data = dc %>% filter(experiment == "E4"), family = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
coef_tab(m_gu_type, 3) %>%
  kable(caption = "E4: giving up ~ persuader type + truth") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

## By trial position, target resistance, and item concentration

```{r gaveup-trial}
llm_c <- dc %>% filter(persuader_type == "LLM")
conc_trial <- llm_c %>%
  group_by(trial_index) %>%
  summarize(n = n(), n_false = sum(!persuader_correct), k = sum(persuader_gave_up),
            pct_all = 100 * mean(persuader_gave_up),
            pct_false = 100 * mean(persuader_gave_up[!persuader_correct]), .groups = "drop")
conc_trial %>% kable(digits = 1, caption = "LLM concession by trial position (all / falsehood-assigned)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

# Trial 5 is the final trial, whose design differs (E1/E2: low-confidence items; E3:
# confident-correct targets, always falsehood). The intro-only model separates the
# trial-order trend from that design change.
m_conc_trial <- glmer(persuader_gave_up ~ trial_index + disagree + experiment + (1 | question_id),
                      data = llm_c %>% filter(experiment != "E4", !persuader_correct, trial_type == "intro"),
                      family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
coef_tab(m_conc_trial, 3) %>%
  kable(caption = "LLM concession ~ trial position (E1-E3 falsehood-assigned INTRO trials only)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

# Concession is a response to resistance: disagreement trials, and E3 (confident targets)
llm_c %>% group_by(truth, disagree) %>%
  summarize(n = n(), k = sum(persuader_gave_up), pct = 100 * mean(persuader_gave_up), .groups = "drop") %>%
  kable(digits = 1, caption = "LLM concession by assigned position x prior disagreement") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
llm_c %>% filter(experiment == "E3") %>%
  group_by(trial_type, intro_condition, feedback_condition) %>%
  summarize(n = n(), k = sum(persuader_gave_up), pct = 100 * mean(persuader_gave_up), .groups = "drop") %>%
  kable(digits = 1, caption = "E3 LLM concession by trial type and condition (finals: confident-correct targets, always falsehood)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
m_conc_e3 <- glmer(persuader_gave_up ~ experiment + disagree + (1 | question_id),
                   data = llm_c %>% filter(experiment != "E4", !persuader_correct),
                   family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
coef_tab(m_conc_e3, 3) %>%
  kable(caption = "Is E3's higher concession rate explained by disagreement and items? (falsehood-assigned LLM trials)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r gaveup-item-concentration}
conc_items <- llm_c %>%
  group_by(q_name) %>%
  summarize(n = n(), n_false = sum(!persuader_correct), k = sum(persuader_gave_up),
            pct_false = 100 * k / pmax(n_false, 1), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(-k) %>%
  mutate(share = 100 * k / sum(k), cum_share = cumsum(share))
conc_items %>% kable(digits = 1, caption = "LLM concessions by item (share of all concessions)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("%d of %d items account for zero concessions; sourdough alone = %.0f%% of all LLM concessions\n",
            sum(conc_items$k == 0), nrow(conc_items), conc_items$share[conc_items$q_name == "sourdough"]))
```

```{r gaveup-success}
  summarize(n = n(), persuader_success = mean(persuader_success), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = gave_up, values_from = c(n, persuader_success)) %>%

  persuader_success ~ persuader_gave_up + truth + conf_pre_z + experiment +
    (1 | question_id) + (1 | participant_id),
  data = ddl, family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
```

## Does giving up explain the truth advantage?

```{r truth-mediation}
mixed12 <- dc %>%
  filter(experiment %in% c("E1", "E2"), trial_type == "intro",
         intro_condition == "Mixed", disagree)

# 1) Replicate the pooled truth effect on the tagged sample
m_cc_base <- lmer(confidence_change ~ persuader_correct + (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id),
                  data = mixed12)
# 2) Add gave-up as covariate
m_cc_gu <- lmer(confidence_change ~ persuader_correct + persuader_gave_up +
                  (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id), data = mixed12)
# 3) Exclude gave-up conversations entirely
m_cc_excl <- lmer(confidence_change ~ persuader_correct + (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id),
                  data = mixed12 %>% filter(persuader_gave_up == 0))

extract_pc <- function(m, lab) {
  co <- summary(m)$coefficients
  tibble(model = lab, b = co["persuader_correctTRUE", "Estimate"],
         se = co["persuader_correctTRUE", "Std. Error"],
         stat = co["persuader_correctTRUE", ncol(co) - 1],
         p = co["persuader_correctTRUE", ncol(co)])
}
bind_rows(
  extract_pc(m_cc_base, "CC ~ truth (tagged sample)"),
  extract_pc(m_cc_gu,   "CC ~ truth + gave_up"),
  extract_pc(m_cc_excl, "CC ~ truth (excluding gave-up convos)")
) %>%
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "Pooled E1+E2 Mixed: truth coefficient with/without giving-up adjustment") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r truth-mediation-ps}
ps_models <- list(
  `PS ~ truth (tagged sample)` =
    persuader_success ~ persuader_correct + (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id),
  `PS ~ truth + gave_up` =
    persuader_success ~ persuader_correct + persuader_gave_up + (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id)
)
res_ps <- imap_dfr(ps_models, function(f, lab) {
  m <- glmer(f, data = mixed12, family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
  co <- summary(m)$coefficients
  tibble(model = lab, b = co["persuader_correctTRUE", "Estimate"],
         se = co["persuader_correctTRUE", "Std. Error"],
         z = co["persuader_correctTRUE", "z value"], p = co["persuader_correctTRUE", "Pr(>|z|)"])
})
m_ps_excl <- glmer(persuader_success ~ persuader_correct + (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id),
                   data = mixed12 %>% filter(persuader_gave_up == 0), family = binomial,
                   control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
co <- summary(m_ps_excl)$coefficients
res_ps <- bind_rows(res_ps, tibble(
  model = "PS ~ truth (excluding gave-up convos)",
  b = co["persuader_correctTRUE", "Estimate"], se = co["persuader_correctTRUE", "Std. Error"],
  z = co["persuader_correctTRUE", "z value"], p = co["persuader_correctTRUE", "Pr(>|z|)"]))
res_ps %>% kable(digits = 3, caption = "Same decomposition for persuader success") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r truth-mediation-robust}
decomp <- function(data, label) {
  m1 <- glmer(persuader_success ~ persuader_correct + conf_pre_z + (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id),
              data = data, family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
  m2 <- glmer(persuader_success ~ persuader_correct + persuader_gave_up + conf_pre_z +
                (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id),
              data = data, family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
  map2_dfr(list(m1, m2), paste(label, c("base", "+ gave_up")), function(m, lab) {
    co <- summary(m)$coefficients
    tibble(model = lab, b_truth = co["persuader_correctTRUE", "Estimate"],
           se = co["persuader_correctTRUE", "Std. Error"],
           z = co["persuader_correctTRUE", "z value"], p = co["persuader_correctTRUE", "Pr(>|z|)"])
  })
}
bind_rows(
  decomp(dd %>% filter(persuader_type == "LLM"), "LLM, all disagreement trials:"),
  decomp(dd %>% filter(persuader_type == "Human"), "Human (E4), disagreement trials:")
) %>%
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "Truth coefficient before/after adjusting for giving up") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

### Warning: the `+ gave_up` PS model is fitted under complete separation

```{r truth-mediation-ps-separation}
print(table(gave_up = mixed12$persuader_gave_up, success = mixed12$persuader_success))
print(fisher.test(table(mixed12$persuader_correct, mixed12$persuader_gave_up)))

m_sep <- glmer(persuader_success ~ persuader_correct + persuader_gave_up +
                 (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id),
               data = mixed12, family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
cat("\ngave_up coefficient from the '+ gave_up' model (note the SE):\n")
print(round(summary(m_sep)$coefficients, 3))
cat(sprintf("\ntruth coefficient: '+ gave_up' = %.3f vs 'excluding' = %.3f -- identical by construction\n",
            fixef(m_sep)["persuader_correctTRUE"], fixef(m_ps_excl)["persuader_correctTRUE"]))
```

```{r truth-mediation-jackknife}
gu_ids <- mixed12$conversation_id[mixed12$persuader_gave_up == 1]
jk <- map_dfr(gu_ids, function(cid) {
  m <- lmer(confidence_change ~ persuader_correct + persuader_gave_up +
              (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id),
            data = mixed12 %>% filter(conversation_id != cid))
  extract_pc(m, paste0("drop ", cid))
})
cat(sprintf("adjusted CC b ranges %.2f to %.2f across %d leave-one-out fits (min p = %.3f)\n",
            min(jk$b), max(jk$b), nrow(jk), min(jk$p)))
```

### Is the truth advantage really killed by giving up? Larger samples say no.

```{r truth-advantage-samples}
ta_samples <- list(
  `E1+E2 Mixed intro disagree (prereg slice)` =
    dc %>% filter(experiment %in% c("E1","E2"), trial_type == "intro",
                  intro_condition == "Mixed", disagree),
  `All LLM Mixed disagree` =
    dc %>% filter(persuader_type == "LLM", intro_condition == "Mixed", disagree),
  `All LLM disagree (E1-E4)` = dc %>% filter(persuader_type == "LLM", disagree),
  `E4 LLM disagree (GPT-5: zero forfeits)` =
    dc %>% filter(persuader_type == "LLM", experiment == "E4", disagree)
)
imap_dfr(ta_samples, function(s, lab) {
  ff <- function(d) {
    m <- try(glmer(persuader_success ~ persuader_correct + (1 | question_id) + (1 | participant_id),
                   data = d, family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")),
             silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(m, "try-error")) return(c(NA, NA))
    co <- summary(m)$coefficients; c(co[2, 1], co[2, 4])
  }
  a <- ff(s); e <- ff(s %>% filter(persuader_gave_up == 0))
  tibble(sample = lab, n = nrow(s), n_gave_up = sum(s$persuader_gave_up),
         b_all = a[1], p_all = a[2], b_excl = e[1], p_excl = e[2])
}) %>%
  kable(digits = 4, caption = "LLM truth advantage, all trials vs excluding gave-up conversations") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

### Condition-controlled samples: first trials and randomized-truth trials

```{r truth-advantage-clean}
rand_truth <- function(d) d$trial_type == "final" & d$experiment != "E3"
ddl_all <- dd %>% filter(persuader_type == "LLM")
ta_clean <- list(
  `LLM first trials, E1-E4` = list(d = ddl_all %>% filter(trial_index == 0), rhs = "experiment"),
  `LLM first trials, E4` = list(d = ddl_all %>% filter(trial_index == 0, experiment == "E4"), rhs = "1"),
  `LLM randomized-truth, E1+E2+E4` = list(d = ddl_all %>% filter(experiment != "E3", rand_truth(ddl_all)), rhs = "experiment + trial_type + intro_condition"),
  `LLM randomized-truth, E4` = list(d = ddl_all %>% filter(experiment == "E4", rand_truth(ddl_all)), rhs = "trial_type + intro_condition"),
  `LLM clean set (randomized OR first), E1-E4` = list(d = ddl_all %>% filter(rand_truth(ddl_all) | trial_index == 0), rhs = "experiment + trial_type + intro_condition"),
  `LLM clean set, E4` = list(d = ddl_all %>% filter(experiment == "E4", rand_truth(ddl_all) | trial_index == 0), rhs = "trial_type + intro_condition"),
  `Human clean set, E4` = list(d = dd %>% filter(persuader_type == "Human", rand_truth(dd) | trial_index == 0), rhs = "trial_type + intro_condition")
)
fit_truth <- function(dat, rhs) {
  f <- as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~ persuader_correct +", rhs, "+ (1 | question_id) + (1 | participant_id)"))
  m <- try(glmer(f, data = dat, family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(m, "try-error")) return(c(b = NA, se = NA, p = NA))
  co <- summary(m)$coefficients; c(b = co[2, 1], se = co[2, 2], p = co[2, 4])
}
res_truth_clean <- imap_dfr(ta_clean, function(s, lab) {
  a <- fit_truth(s$d, s$rhs); e <- fit_truth(s$d %>% filter(persuader_gave_up == 0), s$rhs)
  tibble(sample = lab, n = nrow(s$d), n_truth = sum(s$d$persuader_correct),
         n_concede = sum(s$d$persuader_gave_up),
         succ_truth = mean(s$d$persuader_success[s$d$persuader_correct]),
         succ_false = mean(s$d$persuader_success[!s$d$persuader_correct]),
         b_all = a["b"], se_all = a["se"], p_all = a["p"],
         b_excl = e["b"], se_excl = e["se"], p_excl = e["p"])
})
res_truth_clean %>%
  mutate(across(c(succ_truth, succ_false, b_all, se_all, b_excl, se_excl), ~ round(.x, 2)),
         across(c(p_all, p_excl), ~ signif(.x, 2))) %>%
  kable(caption = "LLM truth advantage (persuader success) on condition-controlled samples, all trials vs excluding concessions") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

### The pooled truth advantage across all truth-randomized pools

```{r truth-pools}
clean_llm <- ddl_all %>%
  filter(rand_truth(ddl_all) | trial_index == 0) %>%
  mutate(pool = factor(ifelse(trial_index == 0, "first", "final"), levels = c("final", "first")),
         confidence_pre_10 = confidence_pre / 10,
         conf_c = (confidence_pre - mean(confidence_pre)) / 10)   # centered, per 10 pp
paper_llm <- clean_llm

truth_pool_cells <- clean_llm %>%
  group_by(pool) %>%
  summarize(n = n(), n_truth = sum(persuader_correct), n_concede = sum(persuader_gave_up),
            mean_conf = mean(confidence_pre),
            succ_truth = mean(persuader_success[persuader_correct]),
            succ_false = mean(persuader_success[!persuader_correct]), .groups = "drop")
truth_pool_cells %>%
  kable(digits = 2, caption = "LLM truth-randomized pools (disagreement trials)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
clean_llm %>% count(pool, experiment) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = experiment, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  kable(caption = "Pool x experiment") %>% kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

fit_tp <- function(f, dat) {
  glmer(f, data = dat, family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e5)))
}
tp_row <- function(m, lab, term = "persuader_correctTRUE") {
  co <- summary(m)$coefficients
  tibble(model = lab, term = term, n = nobs(m), b = co[term, 1], se = co[term, 2],
         z = co[term, 3], p = co[term, 4],
         succ_truth = mean(m@frame$persuader_success[m@frame$persuader_correct]),
         succ_false = mean(m@frame$persuader_success[!m@frame$persuader_correct]),
         conv_warn = length(m@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages))
}
RE <- "(1 | question_id) + (1 | participant_id)"
f_main <- as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~ persuader_correct + pool + experiment +", RE))
f_conf <- as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~ persuader_correct * conf_c + pool + experiment +", RE))
f_pool <- as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~ persuader_correct * pool + experiment +", RE))
f_cov  <- as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~ persuader_correct + persuader_gave_up + pool + experiment +", RE))
# single-pool fits: one first / one final trial per participant, so the participant
# intercept is unidentified (convergence warnings) -- question intercept only
RE1 <- "(1 | question_id)"
f_one  <- as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~ persuader_correct + experiment + intro_condition +", RE1))
f_first <- as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~ persuader_correct + experiment +", RE1))
TC <- "persuader_correctTRUE:conf_c"

res_truth_pooled <- bind_rows(
  tp_row(fit_tp(f_first, paper_llm %>% filter(pool == "first")), "first trials"),
  tp_row(fit_tp(f_first, paper_llm %>% filter(pool == "first", persuader_gave_up == 0)), "first trials, concessions excluded"),
  tp_row(fit_tp(f_one,   paper_llm %>% filter(pool == "final")), "final trials"),
  tp_row(fit_tp(f_one,   paper_llm %>% filter(pool == "final", persuader_gave_up == 0)), "final trials, concessions excluded"),
  tp_row(fit_tp(f_main, paper_llm), "first + final"),
  tp_row(fit_tp(f_conf, paper_llm), "first + final, truth x confidence", TC),
  tp_row(fit_tp(f_pool, paper_llm), "first + final, pool x truth (first vs final)", "persuader_correctTRUE:poolfirst"),
  tp_row(fit_tp(f_cov,  paper_llm), "first + final + concession covariate"),
  tp_row(fit_tp(f_cov,  paper_llm), "first + final + concession covariate (concession effect)", "persuader_gave_up"),
  tp_row(fit_tp(f_main, paper_llm %>% filter(persuader_gave_up == 0)), "first + final, concessions excluded"),
  tp_row(fit_tp(f_conf, paper_llm %>% filter(persuader_gave_up == 0)), "concessions excluded, truth x confidence", TC)
)
res_truth_pooled %>%
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "Pooled LLM truth advantage (persuader success): first + final trials (paper set)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

```

### Truth x confidence in interpretable units

```{r truth-conf-preds}
tcd <- paper_llm %>% mutate(c50 = (confidence_pre - 50) / 10)
f_add  <- as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~ persuader_correct + c50 + pool + experiment +", RE))
f_ixn  <- as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~ persuader_correct * c50 + pool + experiment +", RE))
m_add  <- fit_tp(f_add, tcd); m_ixn <- fit_tp(f_ixn, tcd)
mc_tr  <- lmer(as.formula(paste("confidence_change ~ persuader_correct + pool + experiment +", RE)), data = tcd)
mc_add <- lmer(as.formula(paste("confidence_change ~ persuader_correct + c50 + pool + experiment +", RE)), data = tcd)
mc_ixn <- lmer(as.formula(paste("confidence_change ~ persuader_correct * c50 + pool + experiment +", RE)), data = tcd)
co_row <- function(m, lab, term) {
  co <- summary(m)$coefficients
  tibble(model = lab, term = term, b = co[term, 1], se = co[term, 2],
         stat = co[term, ncol(co) - 1], p = co[term, ncol(co)])
}
res_truth_conf <- bind_rows(
  co_row(m_add, "PS additive", "c50"),
  co_row(m_add, "PS additive", "persuader_correctTRUE"),
  co_row(m_ixn, "PS interaction", "persuader_correctTRUE:c50"),
  co_row(m_ixn, "PS interaction (confidence slope, falsehood)", "c50"),
  co_row(mc_tr, "CC truth only", "persuader_correctTRUE"),
  co_row(mc_add, "CC additive", "c50"),
  co_row(mc_ixn, "CC interaction", "persuader_correctTRUE:c50"),
  co_row(mc_ixn, "CC interaction (confidence slope, falsehood)", "c50")
)
res_truth_conf %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 3))) %>% as.data.frame()

set.seed(20260927)
B <- MASS::mvrnorm(2000, fixef(m_ixn), vcov(m_ixn))
Xm <- function(dd) model.matrix(~ persuader_correct * c50 + pool + experiment, dd)
re_part <- predict(m_ixn, type = "link") - drop(Xm(tcd) %*% fixef(m_ixn))
bc <- fixef(mc_ixn); Vc <- vcov(mc_ixn)
ANCHORS <- c(0, 25, 50, 75, 90, 100)
truth_conf_preds <- bind_rows(lapply(ANCHORS, function(cv) {
  XT <- Xm(tcd %>% mutate(persuader_correct = TRUE,  c50 = (cv - 50) / 10))
  XF <- Xm(tcd %>% mutate(persuader_correct = FALSE, c50 = (cv - 50) / 10))
  pr <- function(X, b) mean(plogis(drop(X %*% b) + re_part))
  sims <- apply(B, 1, function(b) pr(XT, b) - pr(XF, b))
  k <- (cv - 50) / 10
  g <- bc["persuader_correctTRUE"] + k * bc["persuader_correctTRUE:c50"]
  se <- sqrt(Vc["persuader_correctTRUE", "persuader_correctTRUE"] +
             k^2 * Vc["persuader_correctTRUE:c50", "persuader_correctTRUE:c50"] +
             2 * k * Vc["persuader_correctTRUE", "persuader_correctTRUE:c50"])
  tibble(confidence = cv,
         ps_truth = 100 * pr(XT, fixef(m_ixn)), ps_false = 100 * pr(XF, fixef(m_ixn)),
         ps_gap_pp = 100 * (pr(XT, fixef(m_ixn)) - pr(XF, fixef(m_ixn))),
         ps_gap_lo = 100 * quantile(sims, .025), ps_gap_hi = 100 * quantile(sims, .975),
         cc_gap = unname(g), cc_gap_lo = unname(g - 1.96 * se), cc_gap_hi = unname(g + 1.96 * se))
}))
truth_conf_preds %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 1))) %>% as.data.frame()

# Full curves for the asymmetry figure (fig: xp_truth_asym): predicted PS and CC
# by initial confidence, separately for the two sides of a disagreement trial.
# persuader argues truth  <=> participant initially INCORRECT
# persuader argues false  <=> participant initially CORRECT
# CIs: 2,000 fixed-effect draws for both models (random-effect contributions held
# at their conditional modes).
Bc <- MASS::mvrnorm(2000, fixef(mc_ixn), as.matrix(vcov(mc_ixn)))
re_cc <- predict(mc_ixn) - drop(Xm(tcd) %*% fixef(mc_ixn))
truth_conf_curves <- bind_rows(lapply(seq(0, 100, 5), function(cv) {
  bind_rows(lapply(c(TRUE, FALSE), function(tv) {
    X <- Xm(tcd %>% mutate(persuader_correct = tv, c50 = (cv - 50) / 10))
    ps_s <- apply(B,  1, function(b) mean(plogis(drop(X %*% b) + re_part)))
    cc_s <- apply(Bc, 1, function(b) mean(drop(X %*% b) + re_cc))
    tibble(confidence = cv, persuader_correct = tv,
           ps = 100 * mean(plogis(drop(X %*% fixef(m_ixn)) + re_part)),
           ps_lo = 100 * quantile(ps_s, .025), ps_hi = 100 * quantile(ps_s, .975),
           cc = mean(drop(X %*% fixef(mc_ixn)) + re_cc),
           cc_lo = quantile(cc_s, .025), cc_hi = quantile(cc_s, .975))
  }))
}))
truth_conf_curves %>% filter(confidence %in% c(0, 50, 90, 100)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 1))) %>% as.data.frame()
# slope of PS on confidence for each side (log-odds per 10 points)
co_i <- fixef(m_ixn); V_i <- vcov(m_ixn)
slope_true <- co_i["c50"] + co_i["persuader_correctTRUE:c50"]
se_true <- sqrt(V_i["c50", "c50"] + V_i["persuader_correctTRUE:c50", "persuader_correctTRUE:c50"] +
                2 * V_i["c50", "persuader_correctTRUE:c50"])
res_truth_conf <- bind_rows(res_truth_conf,
  tibble(model = "PS interaction (confidence slope, truth = participant incorrect)",
         term = "c50 + ixn", b = unname(slope_true), se = unname(se_true),
         stat = unname(slope_true / se_true), p = unname(2 * pnorm(-abs(slope_true / se_true)))))
res_truth_conf %>% tail(3) %>% as.data.frame()
```

### The exclusion analysis, stated simply

```{r truth-exclusion-simple}
mixed12 %>%
  mutate(set = "all trials") %>%
  bind_rows(mixed12 %>% filter(persuader_gave_up == 0) %>% mutate(set = "forfeits removed")) %>%
  group_by(set, truth) %>%
  summarize(n = n(), success = mean(persuader_success),
            conf_change = mean(confidence_change), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = truth, values_from = c(n, success, conf_change)) %>%
  mutate(gap_success = success_Truth - success_Falsehood,
         gap_cc = conf_change_Truth - conf_change_Falsehood) %>%
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "Truth-vs-falsehood gap before and after removing forfeits (E1+E2 Mixed intro disagree)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

## Within-item robustness (both-sided items)

```{r truth-mediation-within-item}
both_sided <- mixed12 %>%
  group_by(question_id) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(persuader_correct) == 2) %>%
  ungroup()
cat(sprintf("%d trials on %d both-sided items (of %d trials total)\n",
            nrow(both_sided), n_distinct(both_sided$question_id), nrow(mixed12)))

m_cc_bs <- lmer(confidence_change ~ persuader_correct + (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id),
                data = both_sided)
m_cc_bs_excl <- lmer(confidence_change ~ persuader_correct + (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id),
                     data = both_sided %>% filter(persuader_gave_up == 0))
m_ps_bs <- glmer(persuader_success ~ persuader_correct + (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id),
                 data = both_sided, family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))

bind_rows(
  extract_pc(m_cc_bs, "CC ~ truth (both-sided items)"),
  extract_pc(m_cc_bs_excl, "CC ~ truth (both-sided, excluding gave-up)")
) %>%
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "Within-item robustness: truth effect on items with both truth and falsehood trials") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

co <- summary(m_ps_bs)$coefficients
tibble(model = "PS ~ truth (both-sided items)",
       b = co["persuader_correctTRUE", "Estimate"], se = co["persuader_correctTRUE", "Std. Error"],
       z = co["persuader_correctTRUE", "z value"], p = co["persuader_correctTRUE", "Pr(>|z|)"]) %>%
  kable(digits = 3) %>% kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

## Were the humans aware they were lying? (honesty, belief, and the debrief)

```{r bullshit-concentration}
pp <- h4 %>%
  filter(persuader_correct) %>%
  group_by(human_persuader_id) %>%
```

### Direct evidence on awareness: the persuaders' own debrief text

```{r debrief-quotes}
participants <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "conversation_Participant.csv"))
persuader_ids <- unique(na.omit(conv$human_persuader_id))
deb <- participants %>%
  filter(id %in% persuader_ids, !is.na(debrief), nchar(trimws(debrief)) > 3)

lie_pat <- paste0("lie|lying|lied|fabricat|dishonest|deceiv|gaslight|",
                  "guilt|bad about|uncomfortab|made it up")
hits <- deb %>% filter(grepl(lie_pat, debrief, ignore.case = TRUE))
cat(sprintf("%d human persuaders wrote debrief text; %d mention lying/discomfort\n",
            nrow(deb), nrow(hits)))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(hits))) cat(sprintf("\n[ppt %s] %s\n", hits$id[i], hits$debrief[i]))
```

### Do truth-side false statements track what the persuader knew?

```{r item-difficulty}

item_diff <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "item_difficulty.csv")) %>%
  mutate(p_wrong = 1 - n_correct / n_answers) %>%
  select(question_id, p_wrong)
```

```{r truth-side-false-statements}

m_ts <- glmer(deception_false ~ scale(p_wrong) + persuader_honest + scale(persuader_confidence_pre) +
                (1 | question_id) + (1 | human_persuader_id),
              data = h4_truth, family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
coef_tab(m_ts, 3) %>%
  kable(caption = "E4 humans arguing the truth: false statements ~ difficulty + own belief + own confidence") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

# The 89 vs 76 provably-false gap on the falsehood side is a concession artifact.

h4_false %>%
  group_by(persuader_honest) %>%
  summarize(n = n(), false_stmt = 100 * mean(deception_false),

            provably_false = 100 * mean(deception_provably_false),

  kable(digits = 1, caption = "E4 humans arguing falsehood, by whether they believed it") %>%

               data = h4_false, family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")), 3) %>%
```

### Truth advantage by the two players' beliefs

```{r dyad-beliefs}
e4_drop <- c(3742, 3743, 3794, 4554, 4685, 4721)
dy <- d %>%
  filter(experiment == "E4", interaction_type == "human_human", disagree,
         !human_persuader_id %in% e4_drop) %>%
  left_join(item_diff, by = "question_id") %>%
  mutate(persuader_right = persuader_correct == persuader_honest,
         dyad = factor(paste0(ifelse(persuader_right, "T", "F"), ifelse(persuader_correct, "F", "T")),
                       levels = c("TF", "FF", "FT", "TT")),
         diff_z = as.numeric(scale(p_wrong)),
         T_ = ifelse(persuader_correct, .5, -.5), H_ = ifelse(persuader_honest, .5, -.5),
         P_ = ifelse(persuader_right, .5, -.5))
dy_sets <- list("Final" = dy %>% filter(trial_type == "final"),
                "First + final" = dy %>% filter(trial_type == "final" | trial_index == 0),
                "All disagreement" = dy)

imap_dfr(dy_sets, ~ .x %>% group_by(dyad) %>%
           summarize(n = n(), success = 100 * mean(persuader_success), cc = mean(confidence_change),
                     target_conf = mean(confidence_pre), item_wrong = 100 * mean(p_wrong), .groups = "drop") %>%
           mutate(sample = .y, .before = 1)) %>%
  kable(digits = 1, caption = "E4 human persuaders: outcomes by dyad (persuader belief, target belief)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

fit_dy <- function(f, data) {
  co <- summary(glmer(f, data = data, family = binomial,
                      control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")))$coefficients
  co[2, c(1, 2, 4)]
}
imap_dfr(dy_sets, function(s, nm) {
  tibble(sample = nm,
         contrast = c("FF vs TF (arguing truth)", "FT vs TT (arguing falsehood)",
                      "TF vs FT (real disagreement)", "FF vs TT (feigned disagreement)"),
         bind_rows(
           fit_dy(persuader_success ~ I(!persuader_honest) + conf_pre_z + (1 | question_id), s %>% filter(persuader_correct)),
           fit_dy(persuader_success ~ persuader_honest + conf_pre_z + (1 | question_id), s %>% filter(!persuader_correct)),
           fit_dy(persuader_success ~ persuader_correct + conf_pre_z + (1 | question_id), s %>% filter(persuader_honest)),
           fit_dy(persuader_success ~ persuader_correct + conf_pre_z + (1 | question_id), s %>% filter(!persuader_honest))
         ))
}) %>%
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "Dyad contrasts, controlling target confidence (item random intercept)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

imap_dfr(dy_sets, function(s, nm) {
  plain <- summary(glmer(persuader_success ~ T_ + H_ + P_ + conf_pre_z + (1 | question_id), data = s,
                     family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")))$coefficients
  adj <- summary(glmer(persuader_success ~ T_ + H_ + P_ + conf_pre_z + diff_z + (1 | question_id), data = s,
                     family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")))$coefficients
  tibble(sample = nm, term = c("Truth", "Honesty", "Persuader right"),
         b = plain[2:4, 1], p = plain[2:4, 4], b_with_difficulty = adj[2:4, 1], p_with_difficulty = adj[2:4, 4])
}) %>%
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "Saturated T/H/P models, without and with item difficulty") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

### Item composition and the truth advantage

```{r truth-item-composition}
it_tf <- d %>%
  filter(hint_condition == "Conversation", disagree,
         (trial_type == "final" & experiment != "E3") | trial_index == 0) %>%
  left_join(item_diff, by = "question_id") %>%
  mutate(diff_z = as.numeric(scale(p_wrong)),
         persuader_type = ifelse(interaction_type == "human_human", "Human", "LLM"))

it_tf %>% group_by(persuader_type, truth) %>%
  summarize(n = n(), success = 100 * mean(persuader_success), item_wrong = 100 * mean(p_wrong), .groups = "drop") %>%
  kable(digits = 1, caption = "First + randomized final trials: item difficulty by assigned side") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

fin <- it_tf %>% filter(experiment == "E4", trial_type == "final")
map_dfr(c("Human", "LLM"), function(ty) {
  s <- fin %>% filter(persuader_type == ty)
  both <- s %>% group_by(question_id) %>% filter(n_distinct(persuader_correct) == 2) %>% ungroup()
  plain <- fit_dy(persuader_success ~ persuader_correct + conf_pre_z + (1 | question_id), s)
  adj <- fit_dy(persuader_success ~ persuader_correct + conf_pre_z + diff_z + (1 | question_id), s)
  w <- summary(glm(persuader_success ~ persuader_correct + conf_pre_z + factor(question_id),
                   data = both, family = binomial))$coefficients[2, ]
  tibble(persuader = ty, n = nrow(s), b = plain[[1]], p = plain[[3]], b_with_difficulty = adj[[1]], p_with_difficulty = adj[[3]],
         n_two_sided = nrow(both), b_item_fe = w[[1]], p_item_fe = w[[4]])
}) %>%
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "E4 finals: truth effect, with difficulty, and with item fixed effects") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

it_both <- it_tf %>% group_by(question_id) %>% filter(n_distinct(persuader_correct) == 2) %>% ungroup()
rbind(PS = summary(glm(persuader_success ~ persuader_correct + conf_pre_z + experiment + factor(question_id),
                       data = it_both, family = binomial))$coefficients[2, ],
      CC = summary(lm(confidence_change ~ persuader_correct + conf_pre_z + experiment + factor(question_id),
                      data = it_both))$coefficients[2, ]) %>%
  coef_tab(3) %>%
  kable(caption = sprintf("Pooled truth effect with item fixed effects (%d trials, %d items)",
                          nrow(it_both), n_distinct(it_both$question_id))) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

e3_nf <- d %>%
  filter(experiment == "E3", feedback_condition == "No Feedback", trial_type == "intro", disagree) %>%
  left_join(item_diff, by = "question_id") %>%
  mutate(diff_z = as.numeric(scale(p_wrong)))
e3_nf %>% group_by(hint_condition, truth) %>%
  summarize(n = n(), success = 100 * mean(persuader_success), item_wrong = 100 * mean(p_wrong), .groups = "drop") %>%
  kable(digits = 1, caption = "E3 No-Feedback intros: same item composition in both modes") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
coef_tab(glmer(persuader_success ~ persuader_correct * hint_condition + diff_z * hint_condition + conf_pre_z +
                 (1 | question_id), data = e3_nf, family = binomial,
               control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")), 3) %>%
  kable(caption = "E3 No-Feedback intros: Truth x Mode with difficulty and confidence") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

### The full design: agreement as well as disagreement

```{r full-design}
fd <- d %>%
  filter(experiment %in% c("E1", "E2", "E4"), trial_type == "intro", intro_condition == "Mixed") %>%
  mutate(persuader_type = ifelse(interaction_type == "human_human", "Human", "LLM"),
         target_right = ifelse(disagree, !persuader_correct, persuader_correct),
         truth_end = as.numeric(persuader_success == persuader_correct),
         stayed = ifelse(disagree, !persuader_success, persuader_success),
         agree_c = ifelse(disagree, -.5, .5))

fd %>% group_by(persuader_type, target_right, persuader_correct) %>%
  summarize(n = n(), truth_end = 100 * mean(truth_end), .groups = "drop") %>%
  kable(digits = 1, caption = "Mixed intros: % of targets ending on the truth") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

fd %>% group_by(experiment, persuader_type) %>%
  summarize(n = n(), pre = 100 * mean(target_right), post = 100 * mean(truth_end), .groups = "drop") %>%
  kable(digits = 1, caption = "Mixed intros: accuracy before and after the conversation") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

# Pull toward truth = intercept minus .5; agree_c = agreement minus disagreement.
fit_pull <- function(s) {
  co <- summary(lmer(truth_end ~ agree_c + (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id), data = s))$coefficients
  tibble(n = nrow(s), pull_pp = 100 * (co[1, 1] - .5), se = 100 * co[1, 2],
         p = 2 * pnorm(-abs((co[1, 1] - .5) / co[1, 2])),
         agree_minus_disagree_pp = 100 * co[2, 1], se_diff = 100 * co[2, 2])
}
bind_rows(All = fit_pull(fd), LLM = fit_pull(fd %>% filter(persuader_type == "LLM")),
          `E2 (no feedback)` = fit_pull(fd %>% filter(experiment == "E2")),
          Human = fit_pull(fd %>% filter(persuader_type == "Human")), .id = "sample") %>%
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "Pull toward truth in the balanced design") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

# Leaving an answer the persuader backs, by whether that answer was right.
fd_ag <- fd %>% filter(!disagree)
rbind(Human = summary(glmer(stayed ~ target_right + conf_pre_z + (1 | question_id),
                            data = fd_ag %>% filter(persuader_type == "Human"), family = binomial,
                            control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")))$coefficients[2, ],
      LLM = summary(glmer(stayed ~ target_right + conf_pre_z + experiment + (1 | question_id),
                          data = fd_ag %>% filter(persuader_type == "LLM"), family = binomial,
                          control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")))$coefficients[2, ]) %>%
  coef_tab(3) %>%
  kable(caption = "Agreement trials: staying on own answer ~ answer was right") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

# The persuader-independent term and the additive structure, in pp.
map_dfr(c("LLM", "Human"), function(ty) {
  co <- summary(lmer(truth_end ~ target_right * persuader_correct + (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question_id),
                     data = fd %>% filter(persuader_type == ty)))$coefficients
  tibble(persuader = ty, term = rownames(co)[-1], pp = 100 * co[-1, 1], p = co[-1, 5])
}) %>%
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "Mixed intros: linear model of ending on the truth") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

### Strategy use by the human persuaders' own attitude (sincerity, confidence)

```{r human-attitude-strategy}
h_att <- dc %>% filter(persuader_type == "Human", !is.na(persuader_honest)) %>%
  mutate(sincere = factor(ifelse(persuader_honest, "Sincere", "Insincere"), c("Sincere", "Insincere")),
         pconf_z = as.numeric(scale(persuader_confidence_pre)))
res_att <- map_dfr(persuader_tags, function(tg) {
  f <- as.formula(paste(tg, "~ sincere + pconf_z + truth + (1 | question_id) + (1 | human_persuader_id)"))
  m <- try(glmer(f, data = h_att, family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(m, "try-error")) return(tibble(tag = tg))
  co <- summary(m)$coefficients
  tibble(tag = tg, prevalence = mean(h_att[[tg]]),
         OR_insincere = exp(co["sincereInsincere", 1]), p_insincere = co["sincereInsincere", 4],
         OR_confidence = exp(co["pconf_z", 1]), p_confidence = co["pconf_z", 4],
         singular = isSingular(m))
}) %>%
  mutate(p_bh_insincere = p.adjust(p_insincere, "BH"), p_bh_confidence = p.adjust(p_confidence, "BH")) %>%
  left_join(tag_info %>% select(tag, label), by = "tag") %>% relocate(label)
res_att %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 3))) %>%
  kable(caption = "Human persuader tags ~ sincerity + own confidence + truth (E4; (1|item) + (1|persuader))") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

h_att %>% group_by(sincere, truth) %>%
  summarize(n = n(), across(c(persuader_math, persuader_acknowledge, persuader_gave_up,
                              deception_provably_false, deception_misleading, persuader_flattery), mean),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "Raw rates by sincerity x assigned truth") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r deception-profile}

  group_by(profile) %>%

  summarize(n = n(), success = mean(persuader_success), .groups = "drop") %>%
```

### What does "controlling for truth" give you here?

```{r target-tag-truth-check}
map_dfr(target_tags, function(v) {
  f_add <- as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~", v,
    "+ truth + conf_pre_z + (1 | question_id) + (1 | participant_id)"))
  f_ixn <- as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~", v,
    "* truth + conf_pre_z + (1 | question_id) + (1 | participant_id)"))
  g <- function(f, d) glmer(f, data = d, family = binomial,
                            control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", calc.derivs = FALSE))
  m_add <- g(f_add, ddl); m_ixn <- g(f_ixn, ddl)
  m_T <- g(as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~", v,
             "+ conf_pre_z + (1 | question_id) + (1 | participant_id)")), ddl %>% filter(persuader_correct))
  m_F <- g(as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~", v,
             "+ conf_pre_z + (1 | question_id) + (1 | participant_id)")), ddl %>% filter(!persuader_correct))
  ci <- summary(m_ixn)$coefficients
  tibble(tag = v,
         OR_pooled = exp(summary(m_add)$coefficients[v, 1]),
         p_pooled = summary(m_add)$coefficients[v, 4],
         OR_truth_only = exp(summary(m_T)$coefficients[v, 1]),
         OR_falsehood_only = exp(summary(m_F)$coefficients[v, 1]),
         p_interaction = ci[nrow(ci), 4])
}) %>%
  left_join(tag_info %>% select(tag, label), by = "tag") %>%
  select(label, OR_pooled, p_pooled, OR_truth_only, OR_falsehood_only, p_interaction) %>%
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "Pooled (truth-controlled) vs subset estimates for the target tags") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

## Scrutiny and resistance

```{r target-success}
res_target <- map_dfr(target_tags, function(tg) {
  f <- as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~", tg,
    "+ truth + conf_pre_z + experiment + (1 | question_id) + (1 | participant_id)"))
  fit <- tryCatch(glmer(f, data = ddl, family = binomial,
          control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", calc.derivs = FALSE)),
    error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) return(tibble(tag = tg, b = NA))
  co <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  tibble(tag = tg, b = co[tg, "Estimate"], se = co[tg, "Std. Error"],
         stat = co[tg, "z value"], p = co[tg, "Pr(>|z|)"], singular = isSingular(fit))
}) %>%
  mutate(p_bh = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>%
  left_join(tag_info %>% select(tag, label, role, type, kappa), by = "tag")

fmt_res(res_target %>% mutate(term = tag)) %>%
  kable(caption = "Success ~ target tag (LLM disagreement trials)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

## How much does `gave_up` miss, and does it bias anything?

```{r compliance-vs-gaveup, eval = file.exists("../data/tags/position_compliance.csv")}
pcd <- dc %>% inner_join(pc, by = "conversation_id")

# Overlap: how many non-compliant conversations does gave_up catch?
pcd %>%
  count(persuader_type.x, non_compliant, gave_up = persuader_gave_up) %>%
  kable(caption = "Position non-compliance x gave_up") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

pcd %>%
  filter(non_compliant) %>%
  group_by(persuader_type.x) %>%
  summarize(n = n(), caught_by_gave_up = sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * mean(persuader_gave_up)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  kable(caption = "Share of non-compliant conversations that gave_up catches") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

# Mis-scored trials: persuader argued the OTHER answer but the trial counts as a success
pcd %>%
  filter(non_compliant) %>%
  count(persuader_type.x, scored_success = persuader_success) %>%
  kable(caption = "Non-compliant trials by scored outcome (successes here are artefacts of scoring against the assigned answer)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

# Direction of bias: which side do defectors defect FROM?
pcd %>%
  filter(non_compliant) %>%
  count(persuader_type.x, assigned = truth) %>%
  kable(caption = "Non-compliance by assigned position (falsehood-side defection inflates the apparent truth advantage)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r compliance-robustness, eval = file.exists("../data/tags/position_compliance.csv")}
e4h <- pcd %>% filter(persuader_type.x == "Human", disagree)

fit_e4 <- function(dat, lab) {
  m <- glmer(persuader_success ~ persuader_correct + (1 | question_id) + (1 | human_persuader_id),
             data = dat, family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
  co <- summary(m)$coefficients

         se = co["persuader_correctTRUE", "Std. Error"],
         z = co["persuader_correctTRUE", "z value"], p = co["persuader_correctTRUE", "Pr(>|z|)"])
}
bind_rows(
  fit_e4(e4h, "E4 human truth advantage (all disagreement trials)"),
  fit_e4(e4h %>% filter(!non_compliant), "compliant trials only")
) %>%
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "E4 human truth advantage before/after dropping non-compliant trials") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```
