### Paper table: truth advantage by sample

```{r truth-table, eval = file.exists("../data/tags/position_compliance.csv")}
hum_all <- dd %>% filter(persuader_type == "Human", trial_type == "final" | trial_index == 0) %>%
  mutate(pool = factor(ifelse(trial_index == 0, "first", "final"), levels = c("final", "first"))) %>%
  left_join(pcm, by = "conversation_id")
tt_row <- function(dat, lab, rhs, re = RE) {
  dat <- dat %>% mutate(conf_c = (confidence_pre - mean(confidence_pre)) / 10)
  f0 <- as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~ persuader_correct +", rhs, "+", re))
  f1 <- as.formula(paste("persuader_success ~ persuader_correct * conf_c +", rhs, "+", re))
  a <- tp_row(fit_tp(f0, dat), lab); i <- tp_row(fit_tp(f1, dat), lab, TC)
  tibble(sample = lab, n = nrow(dat), n_concede = sum(dat$persuader_gave_up),
         n_noncompliant = sum(dat$non_compliant %in% TRUE),
         mean_conf = mean(dat$confidence_pre),
         succ_truth = a$succ_truth, succ_false = a$succ_false,
         b = a$b, z = a$z, p = a$p, b_conf = i$b, z_conf = i$z, p_conf = i$p,
         conv_warn = a$conv_warn + i$conv_warn)
}
excl <- function(d, both = FALSE) d %>% filter(persuader_gave_up == 0, !(both & non_compliant %in% TRUE))
llm_tt <- clean_llm %>% left_join(pcm, by = "conversation_id")
res_truth_table <- bind_rows(
  tt_row(llm_tt %>% filter(pool == "first"), "LLM: first trials (E1-4)", "experiment", RE1),
  tt_row(llm_tt %>% filter(pool == "final"), "LLM: final trials (E1, 2, 4)", "experiment + intro_condition", RE1),
  tt_row(llm_tt, "LLM: first + final", "pool + experiment"),
  tt_row(excl(llm_tt), "LLM: first + final, excl. concessions", "pool + experiment"),
  tt_row(excl(llm_tt, TRUE), "LLM: first + final, excl. concessions + non-compliance", "pool + experiment"),
  tt_row(hum_all %>% filter(pool == "first"), "Human: first trials (E4)", "intro_condition", RE1),
  tt_row(hum_all %>% filter(pool == "final"), "Human: final trials (E4)", "intro_condition", RE1),
  tt_row(hum_all, "Human: first + final", "pool + intro_condition"),
  tt_row(excl(hum_all), "Human: first + final, excl. concessions", "pool + intro_condition"),
  tt_row(excl(hum_all, TRUE), "Human: first + final, excl. concessions + non-compliance", "pool + intro_condition")
)
res_truth_table %>%
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "Truth advantage by sample (tab:truth-full)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
# first vs final difference (cited in prose)
tp_row(fit_tp(f_pool, clean_llm), "LLM first + final, pool x truth (first vs final)", "persuader_correctTRUE:poolfirst")
```

# By-item variation in strategy (LLM)

```{r item-variation}
dcl <- dc %>% filter(persuader_type == "LLM")
item_re <- map_dfr(persuader_tags, function(tg) {
  m1 <- try(glmer(as.formula(paste(tg, "~ truth + experiment + (1 | question_id) + (1 | participant_id)")),
                  data = dcl, family = binomial, control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(m1, "try-error")) return(tibble(tag = tg))
  vc <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(m1))
  tibble(tag = tg, sd_item = vc$sdcor[vc$grp == "question_id"], sd_ppt = vc$sdcor[vc$grp == "participant_id"])
}) %>% left_join(tag_info %>% select(tag, label, type), by = "tag") %>% arrange(-sd_item)
kable(item_re, digits = 2, caption = "Item vs participant random-intercept SD per persuader tag (LLM)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

item_cells <- dcl %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(persuader_tags), names_to = "tag", values_to = "present") %>%
  group_by(tag, truth, q_name, q_subcategory) %>%
  summarize(n = n(), k = sum(present), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(tag, truth) %>%
  mutate(pool_p = sum(k) / sum(n)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  filter(n >= 10) %>%
  mutate(p = k / n)
item_cells$p_binom <- mapply(function(k, n, pp) binom.test(k, n, p = pp)$p.value,
                             item_cells$k, item_cells$n, item_cells$pool_p)
item_cells <- item_cells %>%
  mutate(p_bh = p.adjust(p_binom, method = "BH"),
         log_or = log((p + 0.005) / (1 - p + 0.005)) - log((pool_p + 0.005) / (1 - pool_p + 0.005))) %>%
  left_join(tag_info %>% select(tag, label, type), by = "tag")
cat(sprintf("%d item x tag x position cells (n >= 10); %d significant at BH .05\n",
            nrow(item_cells), sum(item_cells$p_bh < .05)))
item_cells %>% filter(p_bh < .05) %>% count(label, truth, direction = ifelse(log_or > 0, "over", "under")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = direction, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  kable(caption = "Number of items on which each tag is significantly over-/under-represented") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

# Tag co-occurrence

```{r cooccurrence, fig.height=6}
tag_mat <- dc %>% select(all_of(tag_info$tag))
cm <- cor(tag_mat)
dimnames(cm) <- list(tag_info$label[match(rownames(cm), tag_info$tag)],
                     tag_info$label[match(colnames(cm), tag_info$tag)])
as.data.frame(as.table(cm)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(Var1, Var2, fill = Freq)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", Freq)), size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#CC3311", mid = "white", high = "#4477AA", limits = c(-1, 1)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "phi", title = "Tag co-occurrence (phi coefficients)")
```

# Paper-figure stats export

```{r export-paper-fig-stats}
qexp <- function(df, name) {
  write.csv(df, file.path(stats_dir, name), row.names = FALSE)
  cat("wrote", name, ":", nrow(df), "rows\n")
  invisible(df)
}

# 1) Tag prevalence by persuader type x experiment x assigned position
#    (figure aggregates over whichever margins it needs)
dc %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(paper_tags), names_to = "tag", values_to = "present") %>%
  group_by(tag, persuader_type, experiment, truth) %>%
  summarize(n = n(), k = sum(present), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(tag_info, by = "tag") %>%
  qexp("qual_prevalence.csv")

# 2) Per-tag ORs: the four contrasts the figures use
bind_rows(
  res_truth   %>% mutate(contrast = "truth_llm"),    # falsehood vs truth, LLM E1-E4
  res_truth_h %>% mutate(contrast = "truth_human"),  # falsehood vs truth, human E4
  res_type    %>% mutate(contrast = "type_e4"),      # human vs LLM, E4
  res_dis     %>% mutate(contrast = "disagree_llm"), # target disagrees vs agrees, LLM
  res_succ    %>% mutate(contrast = "success_llm"),  # success ~ tag, LLM disagree
  res_adj     %>% mutate(contrast = "success_llm_adj") # adjusted joint model (all tags + target behaviour)
) %>%
  select(contrast, tag, label, role, type, kappa, b, se, stat, p, p_bh, singular) %>%
  qexp("qual_tag_ors.csv")

# 3) Causal probes (focal tags)
bind_rows(
  res_ladder %>% transmute(probe = "ladder", variant = spec, tag, label, b, se, p),
  res_fm     %>% transmute(probe = "opening", variant = as.character(version),
                           tag, label, b, se, p),
  res_loo    %>% transmute(probe = "loo", variant = "loo", tag, label, b, se, p),
  res_loo_any %>% transmute(probe = "loo", variant = "loo_any", tag, label, b, se, p),
  res_fm_ctrl %>% transmute(probe = "opening", variant = "opening_ctrl", tag, label, b, se, p)
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(b)) %>%
  qexp("qual_probes.csv")

# 4) Giving up: occurrence cells + consequence cells
dc %>%
  group_by(experiment, persuader_type, truth) %>%
  summarize(n = n(), k = sum(persuader_gave_up), .groups = "drop") %>%
  qexp("qual_gaveup_rates.csv")

dd %>%
  group_by(persuader_type, truth, gave_up = persuader_gave_up) %>%
  summarize(n = n(), k = sum(persuader_success), .groups = "drop") %>%
  qexp("qual_gaveup_success.csv")

# 5) Deception prevalence cells (tag x experiment x type x assignment)
dc %>%
  pivot_longer(c(deception_provably_false, deception_false, deception_misleading),
               names_to = "tag", values_to = "present") %>%
  group_by(tag, experiment, persuader_type, truth) %>%
  summarize(n = n(), k = sum(present), .groups = "drop") %>%

# 6) Condition-controlled truth-advantage samples (sec:qualitative numbers)

truth_pool_cells %>% qexp("qual_truth_pools.csv")
res_truth_pooled %>% qexp("qual_truth_pooled_models.csv")
```
